column1: # Derived from the ClinGen gene curation list (ftp.clinicalgenome.org,
# ClinGen_gene_curation_list_GRCh38.tsv). A gene is included when its
# Haploinsufficiency Score is 3 (sufficient evidence for dominant
# haploinsufficiency) or 30 (gene associated with an autosomal recessive
# phenotype). Both encode an established loss-of-function disease
# mechanism per the ClinGen PVS1 decision tree (Abou Tayoun et al. 2018).
# A gene NOT on this list fails closed to PVS1 Strong, never Very Strong.
# ClinGen dosage curation is not exhaustive: some genuine LoF-disease
# genes (e.g. GAA, ITGA2B, RPGR) are not yet dosage-curated and are
# therefore absent here by design, pending a supplementary mechanism source.
